[Benzinga news, 2026-10-27T16:01:38Z, by staff] Teva Acquires Worldwide Rights to BXCL501 from BioXcel Therapeutics
Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd. has acquired the worldwide rights to BXCL501, an investigational sublingual film for the treatment of agitation, from BioXcel Therapeutics for $57.5 million upfront plus contingent payments.
Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd. announced the completion of an asset acquisition from BioXcel Therapeutics, securing worldwide rights to BXCL501. The transaction includes an upfront payment of $57.5 million and up to $67.5 million in potential contingent payments. BXCL501 is an investigational dexmedetomidine sublingual film currently under FDA review for the acute treatment of agitation associated with schizophrenia or bipolar I or II disorder in adults. Teva stated that the acquisition aligns with its 'Pivot to Growth' strategy by adding a late-stage neuroscience asset to its portfolio. The deal received approval from the U.S. Bankruptcy Court and satisfied all necessary closing conditions.
